name: morphic-navbar
title: Morphic Navbar
description: A compact pill navigation bar on black. The active link sits in its own gap-separated pill, hover opens a hairline gap, clicking moves the split, and pressing and dragging across the bar scrubs between links.
use: A small site wants a distinctive top navigation with only a handful of links.
avoid: Many links or long labels: each link is a pill and the split needs room, so the row runs wide.
a11y: Links are real anchors with arrow-key focus movement and aria-current; reduced motion makes the split jump. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Five white rounded links, Home, Work, Notes, Blog and About, form one horizontal bar on a black stage. The active label is darker with a short underline, and small gaps open on each side of it so the bar reads as separate islands, with a thin caption line underneath.
behaves: Choosing a link springs the gaps to surround it and darkens its label; hovering another link opens a small gap around that one. Pressing and dragging across the bar moves the split continuously and a flick lands on a later link, while keyboard focus moves link to link instantly.
customise: Links come in as a record of paths to labels, with an initial active path and an optional compact-on-scroll mode; split sizes and springs are in the source.
weight: light: Five links with spring-driven offsets and a drag listener; idle when untouched.
demo: Links Home, Work, Notes, Blog and About; a caption reads Click a link, or press and drag across the bar to scrub.
issues: Inactive labels are faint on the white pills and the active underline is only a hairline.
polishWhy: Distinctive splitting nav with smooth scrubbing; small labels and the underline read faintly.
